# Qyupe Software Private Limited

> Qyupe Software Private Limited is a subsidiary of EazyStar Systems Inc. (a US-based company) delivering custom software development, bookkeeping, US immigration paralegal services, US company compliance, and PR support to startups and growing businesses under one accountable team.

Qyupe runs on a lean, transparent set of workplace policies designed for maximum productivity and minimum management overhead, published publicly for transparency.

## Services

- Software Development: Custom web, mobile, and cloud applications — architecture, build, and post-launch support with AI-assisted delivery.
- Bookkeeping: Accurate, up-to-date books for US businesses — reconciliations, reporting, and payroll support.
- US Immigration Paralegal Services: Petition preparation and case-tracking support for US immigration filings, working alongside attorneys.
- US Company Compliance: Registered agent support, annual filings, and regulatory upkeep for US entities.
- PR: Press outreach and narrative building.

## Pages

- [Home](https://qyupe.com/): Services overview, about, clients, and contact.
- [Workplace Policies](https://qyupe.com/policies): The 12 workplace policies EazyStar Systems Inc. and its group companies (including Qyupe) operate by.

## Clients

- [eazyPetition](https://eazypetition.com): US Immigration petition platform.
- [trackmypetition](https://trackmypetition.com): USCIS petition tracking platform.
- [saasmart](https://saasmart.us): Simplifying Asset Accumulation and Shielding.
- [eazystar](https://eazystar.us): EazyStar Systems Inc., the parent company.
